title: FactorizedHMR: A Hybrid Framework for Video Human Mesh Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2605.14854v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Human Mesh Recovery (HMR) is fundamentally ambiguous: under occlusion or weak depth cues, multiple 3D bodies can explain the same image evidence. This ambiguity is not uniform across the body, as torso pose and root structure are often relatively well constrained, whereas distal articulations such as the arms and legs are more uncertain. Building on this observation, we propose FactorizedHMR, a two-stage framework that treats these two regimes differently. A deterministic regression module first recovers a stable torso-root anchor, and a probabilistic flow-matching module then completes the remaining non-torso articulation. To make this completion reliable, we combine a composite target representation with geometry-aware supervision and feature-aware classifier-free guidance, preserving the torso-root anchor while improving single-reference recovery of ambiguity-prone articulation. translated_title: FactorizedHMR：一种用于视频人体网格恢复的混合框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.14854v3 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：人体网格恢复从根本上具有歧义性：在遮挡或深度线索较弱的情况下，多个三维人体都可以解释同一图像证据。这种歧义性在身体各部位并非均匀分布——躯干姿态和根节点结构通常受到相对较好的约束，而手臂和腿部等远端关节则更加不确定。基于这一观察，我们提出了 FactorizedHMR，一个对这两种情况区别对待的两阶段框架：首先由确定性回归模块恢复稳定的躯干-根节点锚点，随后由概率流匹配模块完成剩余的非躯干关节姿态。为了使这一补全过程可靠，我们将复合目标表示与几何感知监督以及特征感知的无分类器引导相结合，在保持躯干-根节点锚点的同时，提升了对歧义性高的关节部位在单参考条件下的恢复效果。我们还引入了一个合成数据管线……
tldr: 该论文提出 FactorizedHMR 两阶段混合框架，先用确定性回归恢复稳定的躯干-根节点锚点，再用概率流匹配补全不确定的四肢关节姿态，并结合几何感知监督与特征感知的无分类器引导，显著提升了视频人体网格恢复中对歧义性高部位的重建精度。
en_tdlr: FactorizedHMR is a two-stage hybrid framework that combines deterministic regression for a stable torso-root anchor with probabilistic flow-matching for uncertain limb articulation, improving video human mesh recovery on ambiguity-prone body parts through geometry-aware supervision and feature-aware classifier-free guidance.
